references.text: Nadab and Abihu are mentioned here as sons of Aaron, which establishes their lineage and priestly inheritance.
Nadab and Abihu were called together with Aaron to serve as priests for the Lord.
Prohibition against offering strange fire on the altar of incense, relating to the strange fire that Nadab and Abihu offered.
Refers back to the death of Nadab and Abihu and gives instructions on how Aaron should approach the Most Holy Place to avoid the same fate.
Describes the death of Nadab and Abihu when they offered strange fire before the Lord's presence.
Repeats that Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire to the Lord.
Mentions the death of Nadab and Abihu and that they had no sons.
Instructions about the fire on the altar that must always burn, emphasizing the importance of using the right fire.
Warns that our God is a consuming fire, reflecting the judgment upon Nadab and Abihu.
